candidate_interpretation: If the clinical evidence contract permits versioned exam-term interval entailment, the unchanged frozen numeric subexpressions can be tested using explicit signs observed during the documented adult examination. A future ICU screening measurement is unverified. Keep this chart-derived evidence type distinct from a measured vital if separate primary reporting requires direct numeric data.

candidates.limitation: The authors use a numeric heart-rate threshold or an age-relative alternative; there is no case-level measured value.

candidates.patient_excerpt: 2. On examination she is pale and in moderate discomfort, as well as tachypneic and tachycardic.
candidates.criterion_text: A respiratory rate of at least 20/min or a PaCO2 of 32mmHg or lower or the use of mechanical ventilation;
candidates.limitation: The 2013 public protocol lists tachypnea among SIRS variables, whereas the registration frames the respiratory rate in the four-component shock definition. Neither wording states that a qualitative term supplants measured screening vitals.
candidates.counterexample: A public Canadian adverse-event reporting definition permits tachypnea at 17–19 breaths/min for people older than twelve years; this is a different context and shows that the unconstrained term does not guarantee this trial threshold without a vocabulary contract.
